g.text: Push a sanitised snapshot of your local config (connection profiles, scan rules, custom servers) so teammates can pull it as
Agents on this team's shared servers run at these levels. Your own MCP settings can only make these stricter.
Owner: standard · Admin: standard · Member: readonly · Viewer: readonly
Allowed commands at the standard level: uptime, df, systemctl
Blocked patterns the team adds to Servonaut's own: \bcurl\b
